title: Create Traffic ads
content_data:
This article walks you through the steps to create Traffic ads.


# Introduction
Traffic is an ad objective that drives people to a destination. For instance, you can send people to your website or mobile app.
 
**You can use Campaign Management API to create Traffic ads, and this helps you streamline your ad creation experience, and elevate operational efficiency and scalability.**

# Prerequisites
- You've gained access to TikTok API for Business. See [Get Started - Step by step workflow](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1735713609895937) for details. 
  - To create Traffic ads, you need relevant permissions. See [API Reference](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1735713875563521) to find out permissions required for endpoints (including the endpoints listed in the "Steps" section) and see [Update app permissions](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738855280338946) to find out how to configure permissions.  


# Use Cases
- To learn about how to create a Traffic ad with optimization goal as Destination Visit, see [Optimize Destination Visit in Traffic ads](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1782086241778690).
